title: ICON 1.5 — Foes & Encounters
description: GM only. The foe and legend sheets, the Encounter Designer and the clock board.

steps.title: The GM's tools
steps.content:
This tour opens a foe sheet, a legend sheet, the Encounter Designer and the clock board one after the other.
It uses the actors already in your world: import a foe and a legend from the compendiums first (Compendium tab → Foes, Legends) to see every step. Missing ones are explained in the middle of the screen.

steps.title: Building a foe
steps.content: Class, Elite, Chapter, Faction and Size live in the header. Changing the class or Elite fills in the base stats of the manual's foe table; ⟳ Apply Base Stats in the Foe Builder panel does it again by hand.

steps.title: Templates
steps.content: Drag a faction, Great Culture, job or special template from the Foe Templates compendium onto the sheet: its traits and actions are added, and the chip here takes them away again with ✕. Single traits and actions come from the Foe Abilities compendium, or the + buttons.

steps.title: Actions
steps.content: Target the characters first (hover a token and press T), then ⚔ Attack rolls against each target's Defense and 💥 Damage rolls the damage. Where the action has them: 🎯 Mark marks the one targeted token, 📐 places the action's area on the map and targets everyone inside, 💬 posts the text to chat.

steps.title: Statuses and saves
steps.content: The same Conditions tab as the player characters: click a status to apply or remove it, roll its save from here. The marks placed on this foe are listed at the bottom.

steps.title: Legends and their phases
steps.content: A legend is a boss with phases. Each phase has an HP threshold: when the legend's HP drops to it, that phase becomes ACTIVE, and the actions of the phase are the ones to use.

steps.title: Encounter Designer: the party
steps.content: Tick the player characters who are fighting: the budget at the top right is 2 points per player (spent / budget). A regular foe or a mob costs 1, an Elite 2, a legend the whole budget.

steps.title: The roster
steps.content: The foes and legends to pick from: from the compendiums, from the world (the ones already imported) or both. Filter by faction, class or name and add the ones you want; 🎲 Random fill fills what is left of the budget from the rows shown.

steps.title: Save and deploy
steps.content: Save the encounter under a name to use it later. 📥 Actors imports the foes into a folder; 🗺 Deploy also puts their tokens on the open scene and starts the combat, with the reserves hidden.

steps.title: The clock board
steps.content: Campaign clocks, all on one actor (Create Actor → Clock Board). Click the segments to fill them, hide a clock from the players, post it to chat. Drag ⤓ Map onto the scene to put the clock on the map: the token follows the board live.

steps.title: That's all
steps.content: You can run this tour again from Settings → Tours. The Quick Guide (📖 in the token controls) has the rules at a glance.
